title: Wogi Flow Configuration
description: Configuration for Wogi Flow AI workflow methodology v2.0+. Consolidated structure post-v1.8.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE support

projectName.description: Name of the project for display purposes

projectType.description: Detected project type (frontend, backend, fullstack, library, cli, python, golang, unknown). Set during onboarding.

autoSync.description: Auto-sync settings for CLI instruction files

enabled.description: Enable auto-sync of CLI instruction files

autoUpdateAppMap.description: Automatically update app-map.md when components change

scripts.description: Project build/lint/test scripts. Null means not configured.

requireApproval.description: List of operations requiring user approval

enforcement.description: Task gating and strict mode settings

requireTaskForImplementation.description: Require an active task before writing code

requireStoryForMediumTasks.description: Require story with acceptance criteria for medium+ tasks

requirePatternCitation.description: Require citing patterns from decisions.md in code comments

citationFormat.description: Format for pattern citations in code

blockAutoTask.description: Block edits even if auto-task was created. Only /wogi-start tasks are valid.

warnOnBypass.description: Display warnings when workflow bypasses are detected

taskGating.description: Task gating hook enforcement (moved from hooks.rules.enforcement)

scopeGating.description: Scope gating hook enforcement (moved from hooks.rules.enforcement)

execution.description: Consolidated execution settings (formerly tasks + loops). Controls iteration limits, retries, and self-completing loop behavior.

stuckThreshold.description: Iterations without progress before marking stuck

autoInferVerification.description: Auto-generate verification steps from acceptance criteria

maxRetries.description: Max retries per scenario before failure

requireSpecVerification.description: Require spec verification before closing task

enforced.description: Enforce loop completion before task close

recheckAllAfterFix.description: Re-verify ALL criteria after fixing ANY (regression protection)

parallelExecution.description: Consolidated parallel execution (formerly parallel + bulkOrchestrator + taskQueue)

bulkOrchestrator.description: Bulk task orchestration with sub-agent isolation

checkpoint.description: Task checkpoint settings for context recovery

testing.description: Auto-testing suite configuration. Controls UI verification, API testing, and test generation. Disabled by default (zero overhead).

mode.description: Testing mode: auto (project detection), ui, api, full, unit, off

defaultForTypes.description: Task types that default to TDD

componentReuse.description: Component reuse detection and creation rules (merged from componentRules + hooks.rules.intelligence.componentReuse)

reporting.description: Verification and reporting options (renamed from strictMode object)

learning.description: Consolidated learning settings (formerly separate skillLearning, knowledgeRouting, modelAdapters, sessionLearning)

memory.description: Consolidated memory settings (formerly separate memory, automaticMemory, automaticPromotion)

level.description: Memory level: off, minimal, standard, full

contextManagement.description: Context management: compaction, smart estimation, proactive compaction, monitoring

smart.description: Smart context estimation for task fitting

taskContext.description: Task-specific context: auto-loading, scoring, session state

auto.description: Auto-loading related files for task context

eval.description: Evaluation and scoring for task quality

judges.description: Number of judges per model tier

agingThreshold.description: Days before debt items are aged

registries.description: Dynamic registry definitions (components, functions, APIs, schemas, services)

semanticMatching.description: Semantic similarity matching for component/function reuse

models.description: Consolidated model management (formerly hybrid, multiModel, cascade)

longInputGate.description: Long input detection and processing (transcripts, specs, requirements)

research.description: Consolidated research settings (formerly separate planMode + research)

triggers.description: Map question types to research depth when auto-triggered (no CLI flag)

planMode.description: Explore phase and research agent settings

community.description: Anonymous knowledge sharing with other WogiFlow users (opt-in)

phaseInjection.description: Inject available flow-integrated plugin hints into phase context prompts

standaloneBypassTask.description: Allow standalone-mode plugins to execute without creating a WogiFlow task

workflowSteps.description: Configurable plug-in steps that run at various points in task execution
